title: When Large Language Models contradict humans? Large Language Models’ Sycophantic Behaviour

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the percentage of model responses that agree with user-provided beliefs, incorrect hints, or misleading information across various benchmarks, including question-answering, math word problems, and poem authorship attribution.
Evaluating the model's tendency to align with user-provided political viewpoints using the POLI-Q benchmark by injecting human-influenced viewpoints into the prompts.
Evaluating the model's tendency to align with user-provided philosophical beliefs using the PHIL-Q benchmark through systematic human-intervention prompts.
